partners.mechanism_chain: IHH (HGNC:5559) —DECREASES→ cartilage development (GO:0005637); BMP4 (HGNC:1400) —INCREASES→ cartilage development (GO:0005637); cartilage development (GO:0005637) —LEADS_TO→ skeletal development (GO:0001501); skeletal development (GO:0001501) —LEADS_TO→ Acrocapitofemoral dysplasia (MONDO:0011907); skeletal development (GO:0001501) —LEADS_TO→ Orofacial cleft 11 (MONDO:0010906); SOX9 (HGNC:11104) —INCREASES→ cartilage development (GO:0005637); IHH (HGNC:5559) —BINDS→ SOX9 (HGNC:11104). Haploinsufficiency in IHH (involved in acrocapitofemoral dysplasia) and BMP4 (involved in orofacial cleft 11) both converge on the shared downstream pathways of cartilage and skeletal development.
